system.description: The spell enlarges or reduces a designated object that is less than or equal to 2 dm³ (the shape of the object can be 1 cm thick, 40 cm wide, and 50 cm long, which is equal to 2,000 cm³ or 2 dm³). The enchanter can make it grow twice as large or shrink to half its size; either way, the weight of the object remains constant. The enchanter can also distort the object’s dimensions a bit so that, for example, it grows only in length, but not width, like a rope getting longer but not thicker. When enlarged, a narrow rope of 5 meters (2 cm × 2 cm × 500 cm) may be 10 meters long (fully doubled in length); when reduced, the rope may be 2.5 meters long (fully halved in length).
